setup.title: OpenVerse Setup
setup.welcome_text: OpenVerse is a gaming community that connects people from all over the world using Mii characters. Use OpenVerse to share your gaming experiences and meet people from around the world.

beta_text.first: Welcome to the OpenPak Public Beta! While a lot has changed from the first public beta, OpenVerse is still a work in progress and a lot can change at any time.
beta_text.second: This can and may include a total wipe of the database at the conclusion or during the beta period.
beta_text.third: The website, its software and all content found on it are provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis. The OpenPak does not give any warranties, whether express or implied, as to the suitability or usability of the website, its software or any of its content.

setup.info_text:
OpenVerse is a user-driven gaming community where you can interact with people
                all over the world. You can write or draw posts in game communities or send messages directly to your friends.

rules_text.first: The following are some important guidelines for making OpenVerse a fun and enjoyable experience for everyone. The OpenVerse Code of Conduct contains detailed information, so please read it carefully.
rules_text.second: Posts Can Be Viewed Around the World
rules_text.third: OpenVerse contains many gaming communities where people from all over the world can share their thoughts. When you post in a community, remember that everyone can see it, so please express yourself in a way that everyone can enjoy. Use common sense, and think before you post. OpenVerse is a service that is also accessible from the Internet, so bear in mind that people who don't use OpenVerse may also see your posts. Additionally, any comments you make on your friends’ posts will be seen not by just your friends but by people around the world, too. Please keep this in mind.
rules_text.fifth: In order to keep OpenVerse a fun place for everyone, we ask that you be considerate to other users. Help us keep OpenVerse an enjoyable experience by not posting anything inappropriate or offensive.
rules_text.sixth: Do Not Post Personal Information—Yours or Others’
rules_text.seventh: Remember, knowing someone in OpenVerse isn’t the same as knowing them in real life. Never share your e-mail address, home address, work or school name, or other personally identifying information with anyone on OpenVerse, and never share anyone else's information either. Additionally, if someone you meet in OpenVerse invites you to meet them in the real world, do not accept. OpenVerse is an online community and should not be used to arrange real-world meet-ups.
rules_text.ninth: Some people come to OpenVerse looking for tips and tricks for games, but others want to discover a game's secrets all on their own. Posts that reveal secrets of a game or its story are called "spoilers." If you're posting something about a game that might be a spoiler, be sure to check the Spoilers box before sending your post. This way, people who don't want to be spoiled won't see your post.
rules_text.eleventh: Our goal is to keep OpenVerse fun and enjoyable for everyone. In the event that someone violates the OpenVerse Code of Conduct, we will take appropriate action, up to and including blocking the offending user or console.
rules_text.thirteenth: If you're posting in the community for a game you've played, your posts will have an icon indicating that you've played it.

experience_text.info: Please tell us how you would describe your level of experience with games. You can change this setting later.

setup.analytics_text: OpenVerse uses Cloudflare Web Analytics in order to track how users are using our service. The data collected includes but is not limited to time of visit, pages visited, and time spent on the site. This data is not attached to you in any way, and is not used for advertisements by us or Cloudflare.
setup.ready_text: First check out some communities and see what people from all over the world are posting about. Take this opportunity to familiarize yourself with OpenVerse. You might make some new discoveries along the way!

about.title: About OpenVerse
about.heading: About OpenVerse
about.text: OpenVerse is the social network of OpenPak for Wii U and 3DS. It is run by the OpenPak project and has no connection to any other network.
about.credit: Based on Juxtaposition by Pretendo Network (AGPL-3.0). OpenVerse is free software under the same licence.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.heading: Welcome to OpenVerse
welcome.intro: Share posts and drawings with friends on Wii U, 3DS and the web. Before you start, please read the community rules.
welcome.rule_kind: Be kind. No bullying, hate or harassment.
welcome.rule_family: Keep it friendly for all ages: nothing adult, violent or disturbing.
welcome.rule_private: Keep personal details private, yours and other people’s.
welcome.rule_spam: No spam, advertising or pirated content.
welcome.rule_enforce: Posts that break these rules are removed, and repeat offenders can lose access.

activity.title: Game activity
activity.settings_intro: OpenVerse can post notable moments for you, such as a badge you earned, to the Game activity feed and your profile. It is off until you turn it on, and you pick what is shared.
activity.settings_note: Posts are a short line with OpenPak artwork, never a game screenshot. At most 10 a day; a burst of moments becomes one summary post. Turning this off stops new posts; it does not remove old ones.
activity.read_only: This account is supervised, so activity posts are off.
